General What is GTC? NVIDIA GTC is the premier developer conference at the heart of AI. It’s where developers, researchers, creators, IT decision-makers, business leaders, and students gather to see real-world examples of how AI and accelerated computing are helping tackle the world’s toughest challenges and enabling industries to flourish. What are the official dates of GTC 2027? NVIDIA GTC will take place from March 14–18, 2027. How can I watch the CEO keynote? When registration opens, you can choose an option to see the keynote live. In the meantime, you can watch a replay of NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s 2026 keynote here . Is GTC taking place online or in person? GTC 2027 will be a hybrid event, with in-person and virtual options for attendees. When and where will the in-person GTC take place? NVIDIA GTC will take place at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center and venues throughout San Jose, CA, on March 14–18, 2027. What’s the address of the San Jose McEnery Convention Center? San Jose McEnery Convention Center 150 W. San Carlos St., San Jose, CA 95113 Venue Website Who should attend GTC? GTC offers sessions and training for all technical levels and areas of interest. It’s a unique conference that brings together developers, researchers, business leaders, IT decision-makers, creators, and NVIDIA’s partner ecosystem. GTC attendees have a common goal to learn from real-world examples of AI and accelerated computing. Do I have to register to attend the conference? Yes, registration is required to attend GTC in person or virtually. Registration will launch later this fall. I’m under the age of 18. Can I register for GTC? The minimum age to attend GTC in person is 18. How do I request a visa invitation letter? GTC welcomes all international attendees, and we’re committed to making the process as seamless as possible. As part of your GTC registration, you may request an invitation letter through the registration form. After completing your registration and payment, your invitation letter will be emailed to you within a week. If, for any reason, your visa is denied, we’ll issue a full refund of your registration payment. For additional information, please review the U.S. Visa Application Procedures . Which airport should I fly into? Mineta San Jose International Airport (SJC) is just three miles from the San Jose McEnery Convention Center. Get more information on ground transportation options from SJC. San Francisco International Airport (SFO) is 38 miles from the San Jose McEnery Convention Center. Get more information on ground transportation options from SFO. Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (OAK) is 39 miles from the San Jose McEnery Convention Center. Get more information on ground transportation options from OAK. Who should I contact for more information on sponsorships or exhibiting at GTC? Please email [contact omitted] for more information on sponsorships or exhibits. How can I contact the conference organizers? If you have a question that wasn’t answered here or you have general feedback, please contact us at [contact omitted] . EventSphere is the only official housing provider of GTC, and we don’t endorse booking hotel reservations through any source. Other third-party companies may contact you in an effort to get you to book through them and will often misrepresent themselves as the official housing provider. Should you book a room through any other company, we won’t be able to completely protect you from a non-refundable deposit or lack of reservation. Should you be contacted by someone other than EventSphere, please let us know by emailing [contact omitted] .
